method: Raw 16-bit words were treated as authoritative. Adjacent pairs were recomputed as big-endian unsigned and signed 32-bit integers before applying only natural decimal scales. Transcribed decoded_value columns were not trusted.

findings.detail: None of the supplied raw captures contains the complete pair. New bounded acquisition and an independent frequency reference are required.

At 11:19:44 the three BE-u32/10000 values recompute to 19.616, 21.736 and 20.724 (sum 62.076). This is power-like but has no same-time kW reference, and 0x006A-0x006B was not captured. At the later low-load snapshot the first two pairs were zero and 0x0068 was 0.592, also compatible with a phase-power hypothesis but not proof.

Raw words 2/36568 and 2/55888 are authoritative. They recompute to BE-u32 values 167640 and 186960; divided by the rejected fitted divisor 1790 they are 93.6536 and 104.4469, not the CSV values 93.40 and 142.74. The rows remain evidence of raw words only.
No supplied capture contains these complete words. They may contain an active-power aggregate or family continuation.

Across existing captures BE-i32/10000 varies materially. At 11:19:44 it recomputes to 15.816, 20.852 and 27.492; at the later low-load snapshot it was -0.24, -0.24 and 0. This supports retaining signed interpretations but does not uniquely identify Q, S or another quantity. The phase-current interpretation remains rejected.
No supplied raw capture adequately covers these words. Bounded acquisition is required to test aggregate Q, apparent power and PF family hypotheses.

All eight words are identical in all 37 observations from 11:33:08 through 14:33:09 UTC. The four BE-u32/1e6 renderings remain 1050.0848, 1050.1759, 1050.1262 and 1051.1324 while the recorded natural load changed. Actual semantics remain UNKNOWN; alternate scaling cannot rescue a static live-energy candidate.

eliminations: Legacy 0x001A/0x0020/0x0022/0x0024/0x0026 values are static/config-like and cannot serve as frequency or power references.
0x0064/0x0066/0x0068 divided by 1790 is not an admissible current mapping because the divisor was fitted and the CSV contains conflicting decimal transcription.
0x0210-0x0217 is not promotable as live total kWh.
